name: All Star Bulk Order Block
description: All Star Embroidery Gutenberg bulk-order workflow with WooCommerce and ASE Supplier Sync compatibility.
changelog:
1.1.3

  • Replaced overly small fixed compact-layout typography with responsive clamp()-based sizing across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • The sticky summary/action bar is rendered active immediately from Step 1 whenever the ASBO block is present.
  • Added a one-time 30-second inactivity cue that points customers toward the current sticky Continue action and disappears permanently when activity resumes.
  • Redesigned Step 3 with clearer two-part guidance, restrained All Star navy/gold selected states, icons, and plainer artwork-path labels.
  • Logged-in customers choosing Reuse approved artwork can select from up to 25 of their own recent WooCommerce orders, with a manual fallback when needed.
  • Previous-order selection uses HPOS-compatible WooCommerce order APIs and validates ownership server-side before attaching the reference to the new order.
  • Preserves compact product-detail modal, single-open accordions, Total Saved, 1+ normal-price fallback, checkout hardening, and SanMar, S&S Activewear, Momentec, and multi-supplier compatibility.
